summary: The gate closes the two replay vectors an earlier pass flagged: the marker binds (issue, story) as well as the body digest, so the same plan text cannot be replayed under a different story (P1), and the marker is consumed on the approved save so a later awaiting-approval reset cannot re-approve the same body with no fresh human action (P2). plan approve requires an explicit human --by. No secrets, injection, or data-exposure surface; the marker is ephemeral, gitignored, per-worktree working state.
residual_risks: Trust ceiling (documented and human-accepted in decision 0029): a misbehaving agent could run `plan approve --by <name>` without a real human, exactly like `decision accept` and client sign-off. It is disciplinary and audited (a committed plan-human-approved event records who and when), not cryptographically unforgeable. A truly unforgeable gate needs a plan-mode hook Claude Code does not yet fire (#21282).
